files.content: import * as React from 'react' import { Tooltip as BaseTooltip } from '@base-ui/react/tooltip' export type TooltipProps = { content: React.ReactNode side?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right' align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' sideOffset?: number /** Controlled (`open` + `onOpenChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`). */ open?: boolean defaultOpen?: boolean onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void /** Milliseconds before it opens on hover. */ delay?: number disabled?: boolean className?: string children: React.ReactElement } export function Tooltip({ content, side = 'top', align, sideOffset = 8, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, delay = 120, disabled, className, children }: TooltipProps) { return ( {children}} /> {content} ) }
